description: This file defines a PHP class named Module within the Opencart\\Catalog\\Model\\Setting namespace. The class provides a method getModule to retrieve module information from a database based on a module ID.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: A model class that interacts with the 'module' database table to retrieve module data.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves a module record from the database using the given module ID, returning the settings as an associative array.
